notes: Guide: ink-black programme blocks with a white focus ring, a ruler scale and a red playhead • Guide: one-line titles, and the Abante TV and Bilyonaryo logos are no longer cut off • Bilyonaryo News Channel now shows real listings • Guide: a programme after a gap no longer puts a time inside its pill, so the title is never clipped • Guide: ruler times start on their ticks, so each hour sits over its own line • Home cards wear the guide's white focus edge and the in-player list scrolls without clipping • LIVE is a red dot and word, and channel zapping is gone so the picker is the only way through • Bigger 16:9 poster and one clean meta line on the live info card • Faster guide start, and a decoder fallback stops a codec quirk ending a tune
